subject: AWS listing — usage scenarios, demo flow & evidence clearance
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@orenda-analytics.com>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS listing — usage scenarios, demo flow & evidence needed

Hi Rafael —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The AWS Marketplace product page looks promising; before we push assets into the catalog I need to confirm a few things from your side so our field and procurement teams can align: 

- Can you provide a short set of customer-facing usage scenarios (3–4) that map to buyer personas (platform, data science, infra)? We want concrete example prompts / workloads so our buyers see fit.
- A recommended demo flow (3–5 minute script) that highlights latency/cost tradeoffs and autoscaling behavior.
- Evidence for the hero claims: sample telemetry for latency P50/P95 on a 2k token seq, cost-per-1k-tokens numbers, and SOC2 attestation copy we can attach.

I attached a one-pager of our anticipated usage patterns and a draft SOW to help scope the trial (attachments: Orenda-SOW.pdf, customer-usage-examples.docx).

Could we get a first-pass copy and the evidence binder by EOD Friday? Also happy to slot a 30-min sync — our procurement lead (procurement@orenda-analytics.com) will join.

Thanks —
Elena Park
Head of Platform, Orenda Analytics

On Wed, Jun 18, 2025 at 09:12 AM Elena Park <elena@orenda-analytics.com> wrote:
> [attachments: Orenda-SOW.pdf, customer-usage-examples.docx]

From: rafael_mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@orenda-analytics.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing — usage scenarios, demo flow & evidence needed

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the clear scope — this is doable. Quick plan:

1) Usage scenarios: Rafael will draft three buyer-oriented vignettes (Platform, DS, Product) with sample prompts and expected outputs. Will call out sequence lengths and batching assumptions so your buyers understand cost.
2) Demo flow: a 5-min script highlighting a cold-start vs cached KV flow, throughput during batching, and fallbacks to a smaller model for cost-sensitive paths.
3) Evidence: we will pull a short telemetry snapshot (P50/P95) for a 2k token synthetic test and include a SOC2 attestation blurb and link to our evidence binder.

Attachments I am sharing: productpage-draft.md (first-pass hero + usage snippets) and a Drive link to the evidence binder: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3CexampleEvidenceBinder

Proposed times to review together (30m): Thu 6/19 10:00-10:30 PT or Fri 6/20 14:00-14:30 PT. Which works for procurement?

Also, for the AWS listing we recommend two hero claim permutations so we can A/B quickly: (a) "Predictable, low-latency inference at scale" and (b) "Cost-efficient LLM serving with built-in caching and autoscale." Kim, I'm going to loop you for copy polish and required evidence checklist. Marissa, can you flag any co-sell collateral we should include?

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[attachment: productpage-draft.md]

From: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Park <elena@orenda-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing — usage scenarios, demo flow & evidence needed

Thanks — I reviewed Rafael's draft and pushed a few edits. Key items below (high level):

- Hero claim guidance (short):
  • "Low-latency LLM inference with SLA-backed routing" — supported by P95 data and fallbacks.
  • "Reduce per-token cost with adaptive batching & prefix caching" — include a short graphic in the listing assets.

- Usage scenarios (verbatim snippets to use on the page):
  1) Platform: "Automate model governance reports — process 5k audit logs/day; typical prompt: 'Summarize anomalies from x timeframe' (avg seq: 400 tokens)."
  2) Data Science: "Batch inference for fine-tuned models — run 50k requests nightly; sample prompt & expected output included."
  3) Product: "Real-time chat assistant for support — 300 concurrent sessions, median latencies ~120ms per token under burst."

- Evidence checklist for marketplace procurement:
  • SOC2 Type II (link + date)
  • Data retention / delete policy snippet
  • P50/P95 telemetry snapshot (PNG)
  • Sample billing math (cost per 1k tokens at recommended config)

I've attached a CSV with proposed short hero lines and a recommended order for the usage scenarios (hero-claim-list.csv). Rafael — please update the productpage-draft.md with the snippets and the telemetry figures when you have them.

Kimberly Park
Director, Marketplace & Field Enablement
Redwood Inference
[attachment: hero-claim-list.csv]

From: Elena Park <elena@orenda-analytics.com>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@orenda-analytics.com, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing — usage scenarios, demo flow & evidence needed

Rafael / Kimberly —

This is excellent, thanks. Procurement can meet Fri 6/20 at 2pm PT (we confirmed the slot). A couple quick asks before the call:

- Can you upload the telemetry PNG and the short billing math to the Drive link you shared? Procurement will want line items.
- Please include the SOC2 attestation date and a one‑paragraph summary of our data isolation controls for the listing.
- For co-sell: Marissa, can you drop a one-page field slide (30s demo script + 3 talking points) into the Drive before the call?

If everything looks good on the call we'll request a Private Offer trial and hand the SOW to our legal team. I dropped procurement on a parallel thread and attached the SOW again for reference.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Platform, Orenda Analytics

[forwarded attachments: Orenda-SOW.pdf]
